# Workspace TEXT/BLOB columns the hosted start-up scan reads in full
# (rights_admission.recording_pinned). A new column goes here, or into
# rights_admission.MEMBER_TEXT when a member types its value; see
# tests.test_pilot_rights RecordingPinStartupTest.test_every_text_column_is_classified.
# MEMBER_TEXT plain-text columns are not scanned at all, so a column belongs
# there only when every writer of it is a guarded hosted writer.
